THE PHALANX

Operating out of the Albemarle County Kids House, the Miller, Brooks, and Pelletier alliance forms an impenetrable, decentralized care network and an unshakeable 1980s garage band ecosystem.

Matt Miller

The Crimson Node / Manager

The brilliant, systems-oriented architect of the band. Operating from his Tactile Command Rig, he is the core around which the entire compound orbits.

View Profile

Sarah Miller

Co-Manager / Primary Protector

Standing 6'4", the "Charge Nurse" provides the absolute structural baseline for the family's joint-and-several medical and security architecture.

View Profile

Shiloh Brooks

Rhythm Guitar / Player Two

Matt's 24/7 companion and trusted clinical technician. She anchors the band's rhythm section right next to his manual wheelchair.

View Profile

Emily Miller

Lead Vocals / The Operator

A disciplined Navy brat who flawlessly executes military-style clinical transfers and delivers powerhouse 1980s arena-rock lead vocals.

View Profile

Jessica Brooks

Bass & Synths / The Agent of Chaos

The unfiltered in-house SysAdmin. She commands the analog synthesizers and ruthlessly routes the compound's network to guarantee Matt absolute QoS.

Rachel Miller

Drums / The Naval Artillery

Armed with a refined, highly articulate sailor mouth, she unleashes mathematically flawless artillery strikes on the acoustic drum kit.

Chloe Brooks

Conservatory Flute / The Strategist

The academic anchor with absolute unbothered energy. She elevates the band's progressive sound with her premium classical woodwind training.

Elise & Elodie Pelletier

Guest Vocals / Honorary Flock / Life Partners

The Safe Variable (Right): Elise provides a grounding presence, completely disarming the defensive perimeters of the Kids House and earning the ultimate status as a trusted emergency proxy.

The Husky Diplomat (Left): Elodie seamlessly integrates into the living room puppy pile, effortlessly navigating cross-species debates with Echo and providing safe, joyful energy to the flock.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
